Cadence varies significantly, from fast replenishment for bread (every 2 days) and curd (every 5 days) to slow replenishment for flour (every 53.5 days) and toilet cleaner (unknown cadence). Single-observation items across many categories (e.g., specific vegetables, fruits, cleaning supplies, and snacks) indicate exploratory or situational needs rather than stable habits.
